versions.changelog:
Initial release of image-url-qiniu.

- Downloads images from user-supplied HTTP(S) URLs and uploads them to Qiniu cloud storage.
- Outputs a direct Qiniu image link (MEDIA_URL) suitable for backup, CDN, or Feishu/Outlook-safe sharing.
- Supports file size limits, SSL verification toggling, and download timeouts.
- Requires Qiniu credentials and bucket configuration set via environment variables.
- Enforces public-read bucket and basic content-type/magic number validation for images.
- Error messages are provided on failure for troubleshooting.
